title: Knockout Battle
description:
YEET YOUR FRIENDS INTO ORBITKnockout Battle is a chaotic multiplayer party game where friendships go to die. Punch, blast, explode, and launch your friends into space. If they're still standing, you're simply not using enough rockets.

EVERY WEAPON IS A BAD DECISIONBring absolute chaos with an arsenal of ridiculous weapons. Throw TNT like it's confetti. Fire rockets at everything that moves. Blast your rivals with revolvers and blasters. Bonk them with Thor's Hammer. Deflect attacks with a lightsaber. There are no bad choices. Only louder ones.

DRINK QUESTIONABLE POTIONSNeed an unfair advantage? Chug a potion.

Become an absolute Giant. Shrink into a tiny menace. Sprint around the map at ridiculous speed. Hit so hard your friends start questioning their life choices.

Every potion turns the match into even bigger chaos.

WHEN IN DOUBT, PRESS THE NUKE BUTTONSometimes rockets aren't enough.

Sometimes TNT isn't enough.

Sometimes your friends have been annoying for the last five rounds.

Drop a NUKE and let everyone deal with the consequences.

PURE PARTY GAME CHAOSWhether you're dodging rockets, spamming explosives, or laughing as your best friend gets deleted from existence, every match is packed with ridiculous moments you'll immediately want to replay.

Just remember.

If nobody is flying through the air, you're doing it wrong.

Key Features• Chaotic multiplayer battles for 2 to 10 players

• Launch your friends into space with ridiculous weapons

• Use rockets, TNT, revolvers, blasters, Thor's Hammer, lightsabers, and more

• Drink potions to grow huge, shrink tiny, move faster, or hit harder

• Interactive maps packed with traps, hazards, and destruction

• Endless combinations of weapons, potions, and hilarious accidents

• Explosions. Lots and lots of explosions.

• Skins (all are free)

• Achievements
description_short: Knockout Battle is a chaotic multiplayer party game where you absolutely destroy your friends! Turn them into a thousand pieces and yeet them straight into space! Drink potions to get huge, fast like Flash, or strong like Hulk. Use guns, Thor’s hammer, or casually drop a NUKE!
